description: An abstract class providing base functionality for AWS configuration providers, including caching, chaining, and environment handling.

classes.name: AbstractConfigurationProvider
classes.description: Provides base functionality for AWS configuration providers, including caching mechanisms, configuration chaining, environment variable handling, and promise-based methods.

methods.name: cache
methods.description: Wraps a config provider with caching logic, storing the configuration in a cache interface and returning cached results when available.

methods.name: chain
methods.description: Creates a composite configuration provider that invokes multiple providers sequentially until one returns configuration.

methods.name: getHomeDir
methods.description: Determines the user's home directory based on environment variables, supporting Linux/Unix and Windows.

methods.name: getDefaultConfigFilename
methods.description: Retrieves the default AWS config file location based on environment variables or default path.

methods.name: memoize
methods.description: Caches the result of a configuration provider to avoid repeated calls, supporting promise-based asynchronous operation.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Returns a rejected promise with a standardized exception message.
